style.vernacular: Portuguese-colonial Baixa grid (1890s-1960s) of 3-6 storey neoclassical, art-deco and tropical-modernist blocks in painted render (cream, ochre, pale green, terracotta) with arcaded ground floors and balconies, avenues shaded by acacia/jacaranda and palms, calcada-style paved squares; outer suburbs (Mafalala, Xiquelene) are low block-and-zinc houses with corrugated metal roofs; Soviet-era and 1970s brutalist/modernist state buildings, plus recent glass towers on the Marginal.
style.ornament: Neoclassical pilasters and cornices, Manueline-style arches and stone ropework (Portuguese royal style), art-deco curved balconies and ribbon windows, wrought-iron latticework and verandas, Pancho Guedes-style tropical-modernist sculptural facades, painted murals and market umbrellas.
